label: The architecture
subgoals: Select each device's register with its current instruction
Count the boundary register length for devices in EXTEST
Count one bit for each device in BYPASS and sum along the chain

label: Interconnect testing
subgoals: Give each net one bit per parallel test vector
Exclude the all-0 and all-1 codes
Take the ceiling of log base 2 of N plus 2 for the vector count

label: Test time
subgoals: Charge L plus 5 cycles for each DR scan from Run-Test/Idle
Charge I plus 6 cycles for each IR scan
Divide the total cycles by the TCK frequency
